title: ONE BAR FOR EVERY METER
why: Styling across the HUD (his order of 2026-10-03): health, armour, stamina and every progress bar were flat rectangles. They are rounded capsules now with a dark track, a fill lit along its top and its own colour through the middle, a thin highlight and a rounded steel ring. Same positions, sizes and fractions everywhere.
now: Health, armour, stamina and progress bars are rounded, shaded capsules.
